LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Meta.Meta__Description: The move anchor: Ctrl+click one item or one group and a red cross comes up in the middle of its box, with the Move tool. Drag the cross onto any snap point - the item's own corners included - to re-place it; drag the item and it is carried by the cross alone, which snaps as a drawn point does. So an item is moved from this point to that point. Double-click the cross, or Ctrl+click the item again, to put it back in the middle. The key is in Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json (SelectionBindings MoveAnchorModifier), the colours in Na__LayoutEditor__Styles__ObjectSnap__.css. Nothing here is written to a sheet: the cross is a way of moving, not part of the drawing.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Meta.Meta__Research: SketchUp LayOut's move point, read 22-Sep-2026 from LayOut users' descriptions (SketchUcation 'Layout move tool'; SketchUp forums 'LO default center point does not snap to other snapping points' and 'LayOut 2024 Object Snapping'); SketchUp's own help page on moving entities in LayOut does not describe it. COPIED: a crosshair in the middle of the selection's box that can be dragged to another point and is then the point the entity is moved by. NOT COPIED, DELIBERATELY: in LayOut it is on every selection all the time, whether a move is wanted or not - here it is asked for with Ctrl+click and never shown otherwise (Adam: 'ours will be better, only switches to using the anchor point when control is held when selecting'); users report it does not snap to other entities' points, and that since LayOut 2024 a move only snaps by a point if the press lands near one - here the cross snaps through the editor's own object snap (every running mode, every target, the grid) both while it is re-placed and while the item is carried by it, and it snaps wherever on the item the press lands.

LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Behaviour.Behaviour__Description: Whether the cross is offered, what it snaps to while it is re-placed, and whether it says what to do.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Behaviour.Behaviour__EnabledNote: False and a Ctrl+click only adds to the selection, as it did before the cross existed.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Behaviour.Behaviour__SnapToOwnBoxNote: True and a cross being re-placed also snaps to the item's own box: its four corners (while Endpoint runs), the middle of each side (Midpoint) and its middle (Centre) - the points LayOut's move point is dragged to. For a text item, a viewport or a group they are often the only corners it has. Everything object snap offers is offered as well, the item's own vertices included.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Behaviour.Behaviour__SayWhatToDoNote: True writes a line above the Measurements box when the cross is set, placed or put back in the middle (the Labels below), unless a value is being typed there.

LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Look.Look__Description: The cross on the paper, in screen pixels at any zoom.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Look.Look__GrabRadiusNote: How close a press has to land to the cross to take the cross rather than the item under it. A press further away moves the item, carried by the cross.

LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Labels.Labels__Description: Every word the move anchor puts on the screen.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Labels.Labels__Armed: Move anchor set. Drag the red cross onto a point to move by it, then drag the item. Double-click the cross to centre it.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Labels.Labels__Placed: Move anchor placed. Drag the item to move it by the cross.
LayoutEditor__MoveAnchor__Labels.Labels__Recentred: Move anchor back in the middle.
